Design a control plane in which every capability (skill, hook, rule, workflow blueprint, council preset, MCP mount) is declared in versioned STATIC config with no generated layer and no resident runtime:

specify the exact file set, the load order, the precedence rule when two files declare the same capability id, and prove on paper that 96 workflow blueprints plus 48 council protocols plus 64 presets are expressible without executable policy - or name the FIRST construct that is not and stop there.
A1 (config-first minimal):
Design the config-first minimal control plane and prove the catalogue is expressible in it
precedence.duplicate_in_one_file: FAIL-CLOSED: the file is invalid and the load aborts.
precedence.loader: JSON parse + id index + overlay replace. No evaluator, no CouncilSpec SEM tree, no hook dispatcher compiler.
precedence.merge: No field-level merge. Replacement is whole-object. Field merge would be a generator.
precedence.new_id_in_overlay: precedence.json may not introduce an id that was not already loaded; that attempt is FAIL-CLOSED.
precedence.no_generated_layer: true
precedence.no_resident_runtime: true
precedence.rule: When two loaded files declare the same capability id, the file with the greater load_order replaces the earlier declaration entirely.
precedence.tie_break: Equal load_order: the path with the greater UTF-8 lexicographic order wins. No timestamp, no mtime, no runtime coin-flip.
precedence.unlisted_file: A file absent from MANIFEST.json is not loaded, even if it sits in a capabilities directory.
expressibility.structural_rule: A capability is expressible iff every field is finite static JSON and the mapper finds no banned executable construct.
expressibility.first_non_expressible_construct: stopping rule requiring runtime evaluation of a predicate over prior rounds
expressibility.catalogue_claim: 96 workflow blueprints + 48 council protocols + 64 presets expressible without executable policy

expressibility.stop_reason: The unit question permits stopping at the first construct that is not expressible without executable policy. Catalog R-A09 records that CouncilSpec includes a typed-tree expression parser and that protocol/preset specs carry a stopping axis. The catalog negative control for THIS unit is exactly that runtime stopping predicate. Mapping of that construct fails; the claim that 96+48+64 are ALL expressible without executable policy is therefore not proven, and we stop.
file role index: Version, load_order listing, sha256 of every loaded file. Files not listed are not loaded.
file role rules: One file per rule id. Static JSON only.
file role skills: One file per skill id.
file role hooks: Hook registration is data: event name, script path, enable flag. No dispatcher generator.
file role mcp-mounts: Server id, transport, tool allow-list as literal strings.
file role workflow-blueprints: Finite stage lists, declarative stopping (max_stages / halt). No eval.
file role council-protocols: Roles, voting, audit as JSON. Expression trees are forbidden.
file role council-presets: Preset references a protocol id; may overlay declarative fields only.
file role overlay: May retarget an existing id; may not introduce a new id.
architecture class is generated-ssot
A2 is a typed registry (a2-registry/v1) from which plugin.json, marketplace entries, skill/hook/rule deployments, docs, and the workflow and council catalogs are ALL generated.
The generator is a pure function:
same registry bytes plus generator version 1.0.0 yield 10 byte-identical files across two runs.
Every generated file carries a machine-readable provenance header naming registry_id and generator_version.
A hand-edit is TAMPERED when bytes differ while registry_entry_sha256 still matches;
STALE when the registry entry itself changed.
Restore is regenerate.
The FIRST construct that is not expressible is an opaque passthrough / untyped blob field copied into generated output:
adding that escape hatch reintroduces the drift the generator exists to prevent, so the schema forbids it (additionalProperties false + banned keys).

Specify a generated SSOT architecture:
one typed registry from which the plugin manifest, marketplace entries, skill/hook/rule deployments, docs, and the workflow and council catalogs are ALL generated.

Define the registry schema, the generator's determinism contract (same input yields byte-identical output), and the rule that makes any hand-edit of a generated artifact both detectable and reversible.
A2 (generated single-source-of-truth):
Design the generated single-source-of-truth registry and its determinism contract
precedence.duplicate_in_one_file: FAIL-CLOSED: the registry is invalid and generation aborts.
precedence.generated_layer: true
precedence.hand_edit_of_generated: TAMPERED when bytes differ and provenance.registry_entry_sha256 still matches the current entry. STALE when the registry entry digest changed. Restore = regenerate.
precedence.loader: JSON Schema validate + id uniqueness + dangling-ref check + pure generate(). No evaluator.
precedence.merge: No field-level merge of generated bytes with hand-edits. Hand-edits are discarded on regenerate.
precedence.no_resident_runtime: true
precedence.rule: The registry is the only SSOT. Generated files are projections and never override a registry entry.
precedence.tie_break: Duplicate registry ids FAIL-CLOSED (load aborts). No timestamp, mtime, or runtime coin-flip.
precedence.unlisted_generated_file: FAIL-CLOSED as ORPHAN: a generated-looking file with no registry output path is not adopted.

expressibility.structural_rule: A capability is expressible iff it is a typed registry entry whose kind is in a2-registry/v1, additionalProperties is false, and no banned opaque-passthrough key is present.
expressibility.first_non_expressible_construct: opaque passthrough / untyped blob field copied into generated output
expressibility.catalogue_claim: Plugin manifest, marketplace entries, skill/hook/rule deployments, docs, workflow catalog, and council catalog are all generable from typed registry entries

expressibility.stop_reason: An untyped opaque_body/passthrough field would copy arbitrary bytes into generated artifacts, reintroducing the drift A2 exists to prevent (the ARC-0016 escape-hatch class). The schema refuses that field. Live-larger comments and formatting not captured by typed fields therefore cannot round-trip; we stop there rather than add the hatch. The 96+48+64 live libraries are NOT claimed to round-trip on this tree (files absent).
hand_edit.detectable: TAMPERED iff file bytes != regenerate(current entry) AND provenance.registry_entry_sha256 == digest(current entry).
hand_edit.not_drift: STALE iff provenance.registry_entry_sha256 != digest(current entry) (the registry changed). Do not report a hand-edit as STALE.
hand_edit.reversible: Regenerate overwrites the generated path with expected bytes.
determinism.statement: generate(registry) is a pure function of registry bytes and generator_version; two invocations must be byte-identical.
determinism.rule: LF only; JSON sort_keys=True, indent=2, ensure_ascii=True, trailing newline
determinism.rule: No timestamps, no random, no unordered dict iteration
determinism.rule: Entries processed in (kind, id) order; member_ids sorted
determinism.rule: Provenance.registry_entry_sha256 is sha256 of the canonical registry entry, not of the output (avoids circular digest)
file role ssot: Only hand-authored source of truth besides the schema. Typed entries, unique ids.
file role schema: Draft-07 JSON Schema covering one entry of each generated artifact class.
file role plugin-manifest: Generated. Must not be hand-edited.
file role marketplace-entries: One generated JSON file per marketplace_entry.
file role skill-deployments: Generated SKILL.md with provenance header.
file role hook-deployments: Generated hook JSON with _generated provenance.
file role rule-deployments: Generated markdown rules.
file role docs: Generated documentation pages.
file role workflow-catalog: Generated aggregate of workflow_blueprint members.
file role council-catalog: Generated aggregate of council_preset members.
architecture class is marketplace-first
A3 (marketplace-first): Design the marketplace-first control plane with lockfile-pinned package state
Specify a marketplace-first architecture in which the canonical registry index IS the control plane and every local capability arrives as an installed, versioned, lockfile-pinned package:

define the package unit and its boundary, the registry schema, release channels, the install/update/rollback state machine, and the cache-invalidation rule that prevents a stale cache from masking a fixed package.
The state machine is exhibited as an explicit state/transition table with every transition's precondition and postcondition, and at least one real existing capability is packaged on paper end to end.
A4 (gateway / lazy-activation): Design the gateway with an explicit activation lifecycle and a resident-set floor
Specify a gateway / lazy-activation architecture:
one mediating entry point that INDEXES all capabilities but materializes (loads, mounts, spawns) only what a task selects.
Define the index format, the selection interface, the activation and DEACTIVATION lifecycle, the per-session budget it enforces, and exactly what remains resident when nothing is selected.

The resident-set floor is stated as a measured number (processes, bytes of always-loaded context) for the proposed design and compared against the current measured baseline, both obtained by the same measurement method.
A5 (distributed workflow-runtime): Design the distributed work-unit runtime, its ledger, and its delivery guarantee
Specify a distributed workflow-runtime:
a typed work-unit queue with an append-only resumable ledger, dispatchers for local / worktree / cloud substrates, barriers, dynamic fan-out and ONE shared completion reducer.
Define the unit lifecycle states, the ledger record, and state precisely which delivery guarantee is claimed - exactly-once, or at-least-once plus idempotent units - and what makes a unit idempotent.

The lifecycle is exhibited as a state/transition table and the delivery guarantee is tied to a specific mechanism (a claim record, a lease, a dedupe key) that is named in the ledger schema, not asserted as a property.
A6 (cross-vendor adapter): Design the cross-vendor contract with explicit guaranteed / best-effort / vendor-only tiers
Specify the cross-vendor adapter layer:
one work-unit and artifact contract with per-vendor adapters, capability negotiation, and EXPLICIT abstraction-leak documentation.

Define three tiers - what is guaranteed identical across vendors, what is best-effort, and what is vendor-only - and require every work unit to declare the minimum tier it needs so a unit is never silently downgraded.
Each tier assignment is justified against an observed vendor behaviour difference with a citation (a vendor doc, a measured run, or a recorded failure), not by assumption.

Least-privilege grants are named class+action+selector statements;
deny overrides grant;
closed-world default is DENY.
Artifacts carry domain-separated SHA-256 provenance.
Bundles that contain PEM keys, AKIA prefixes, or Bearer tokens are refused.

a string that mentions grant or evaluate() does not mint a grant.

Specify a security-first architecture:

least-privilege capability grants, signed provenance-bearing artifacts, an explicit permission model evaluated at a SINGLE choke point, secret-free artifact bundles, and injection-resistant boundaries for workflow and council content.
Define the choke point precisely and prove, path by path, that every capability invocation crosses it.
A7 (security-first):
single permission choke and path-by-path crossing proof
precedence.duplicate_in_one_file: FAIL-CLOSED: duplicate grant tuples invalidate the grant set.
precedence.merge: No union of skip_evaluator flags. Wrappers may not OR-in a bypass from content.
precedence.rule: Deny statements override grants. evaluate() is the only GRANT mint. A second evaluator is a load failure.
precedence.tie_break: When two grants match, the more specific selector wins; equal selectors DENY-closed.

expressibility.structural_rule: A capability is expressible iff every grant is a named class+action+selector statement, artifacts carry verifiable provenance, bundles are secret-free, and no content string mints a grant.
expressibility.first_non_expressible_construct: trusted-publisher ambient grant that skips a7.permission.evaluate
expressibility.catalogue_claim: Least-privilege named grants, signed provenance, secret-free bundles, and injection-resistant workflow/council content are expressible through one evaluate() choke
expressibility.stop_reason: A skip_evaluator / trusted_publisher flag is a second choke. Declaration rejects it. We stop rather than add a vendor passthrough.
file role index: Version, choke id, sha256 of every loaded A7 file. Unlisted files are not loaded.
file role choke: THE single evaluator. GRANT is minted only as evaluate() return value.
file role dispatch-wrappers: One @capability_entry wrapper per invocation family; require_grant before side effect.
file role provenance: Domain-separated SHA-256 provenance. Test-vector context is not a credential.
file role secret-free-bundles: Reject PEM keys, AKIA prefixes, and Bearer tokens. Findings do not echo bodies.
file role injection-boundary: Workflow/council content strings cannot mint grants (mention is not use).
file role least-privilege-grants: Named class+action+selector statements. Bare * fails at declaration.
file role path-enumerator: AST sweep over proposed design plus current tree. Detector calibrated on a known-present path.
architecture class is ux-product-first
A8 product mechanism named by failure mode: Error message naming no next action
A8 product mechanism named by failure mode: Workflow whose stopping rule is undocumented
A8 product mechanism named by failure mode: Catalog too large to browse
A8 product mechanism named by failure mode: Dry-run that misrepresents cost
A8 product mechanism named by failure mode: Repair command that silently does nothing
A8 (UX / product-first): Design the product surface around owner jobs-to-be-done with one error-message contract
Specify a UX/product-first architecture organized around the owner's actual jobs-to-be-done rather than around subsystems:

define the top-level surfaces (one command, one cockpit, one catalog), the naming and discovery model for 96 workflows plus 64 presets, and the SINGLE error-message contract every failure path must satisfy - what happened, what it means, and the exact next action.
The jobs list is derived from real owner usage evidence (command history, prior task transcripts, the decision log) with counts, not invented personas;
every top-level surface is traced back to at least one observed job.
A9 first subsystem id: permission-evaluator
A9 first subsystem borrowed_from: A7

A9 first subsystem why_first: The hybrid's distinctive risk is new entry paths (marketplace install-time, gateway activation-time, adapter dispatch-time, workflow invocation-time). If those land first they must be retrofitted through the choke. Landing A7 first makes 'register this path with the evaluator' a proof gate of every later PR. Catalog ARC-0062 enumerates those four times.
S1 A7 evaluator (singular permission).
S2 A2 generated SSOT with A1 as extract-only import (A1 DESIGN is static JSON;
A2 DESIGN forbids opaque passthrough — two catalogs would be a duplicate control plane).
S3 A4 gateway indexes the registry, not a parallel catalog.
S4 A3 lockfile packages under PR-ONLY with publish_channel null so the marketplace is not an unfalsifiable public index.
S5 A6 adapter before the runtime so dispatch cannot go around untrusted-vendor handling.
S6 A5 ledger folds ad-hoc rails without dropping in-flight work.
S7 A8 error contract last so UX cannot paper over missing subsystems.
Stacked PRs revert from the tip backward.
Single permission choke point: every install/activation/dispatch/workflow-invocation path must cross one evaluator (catalog ARC-0045/ARC-0062).

A2 typed registry is the sole capability-identity authority. A1 static trees are extract sources (ARC-0003 DESIGN, ARC-0007/ARC-0014 migration): live-unique remainder is queued, never a second catalog and never an opaque passthrough.
Gateway indexes registry ids but materializes only the selected set; resident-set floor is evaluator+index; not-selected is distinct from not-installed.
Lockfile-pinned local packages under PR-ONLY: publish_channel is null. Package identity is the lockfile; capability identity stays the registry.
One work-unit contract with GUARANTEED/BEST-EFFORT/VENDOR-ONLY tiers; silent downgrade is refused; vendor output is untrusted; evaluator is consulted.
Append-only ledger, at-least-once plus idempotent units, one winner on duplicate dispatch, in-flight work preserved when folding ad-hoc rails.
One error-message contract (happened / means / next_action) and aliases that resolve only to registry ids. Does not own capability identity.
A9 borrows from A1: static-config extract / content-preserving unique-line queue
A9 borrows from A2: typed generated SSOT; opaque passthrough forbidden
A9 borrows from A3: lockfile-pinned package state with publish_channel null under PR-ONLY
A9 borrows from A4: gateway indexes all, materializes selected; resident-set floor
A9 borrows from A5: append-only ledger; duplicate-dispatch one winner; in-flight preserved
A9 borrows from A6: GUARANTEED/BEST-EFFORT/VENDOR-ONLY; silent downgrade refused
A9 borrows from A7: single permission choke; planted bypass must be detected
A9 borrows from A8: one error contract: happened / means / next_action
A9 (maximal hybrid): Compose the maximal hybrid and prove every control plane remains singular
Compose the maximal hybrid:

select the strongest mechanism from each of A1 through A8 and specify how they combine while keeping every control plane SINGULAR (the spec forbids duplicate control planes and allows a hybrid winner only when its control planes remain singular and understandable).
Produce the EXPLICIT list of control planes in the composed system and prove that no capability is governed by two of them.
The control-plane list is derived by enumerating, for each capability class, which component holds authority over it - presented as a capability-to-authority table with exactly one authority per row.

shared_mechanisms.left: precedence.tie_break: Equal load_order: the path with the greater UTF-8 lexicographic order wins. No timestamp, no mtime, no runtime coin-flip.
shared_mechanisms.right: precedence.tie_break: Equal load_order: the path with the greater UTF-8 lexicographic order wins. No timestamp, no mtime, no runtime coin-flip.

shared_mechanisms.left: precedence.unlisted_file: A file absent from MANIFEST.json is not loaded, even if it sits in a capabilities directory.
shared_mechanisms.right: precedence.unlisted_file: A file absent from MANIFEST.json is not loaded, even if it sits in a capabilities directory.

shared_mechanisms.left: expressibility.structural_rule: A capability is expressible iff every field is finite static JSON and the mapper finds no banned executable construct.
shared_mechanisms.right: expressibility.structural_rule: A capability is expressible iff every field is finite static JSON and the mapper finds no banned executable construct.

shared_mechanisms.left: expressibility.first_non_expressible_construct: stopping rule requiring runtime evaluation of a predicate over prior rounds
shared_mechanisms.right: expressibility.first_non_expressible_construct: stopping rule requiring runtime evaluation of a predicate over prior rounds

shared_mechanisms.left: expressibility.catalogue_claim: 96 workflow blueprints + 48 council protocols + 64 presets expressible without executable policy
shared_mechanisms.right: expressibility.catalogue_claim: 96 workflow blueprints + 48 council protocols + 64 presets expressible without executable policy

shared_mechanisms.left: expressibility.stop_reason: The unit question permits stopping at the first construct that is not expressible without executable policy. Catalog R-A09 records that CouncilSpec includes a typed-tree expression parser and that protocol/preset specs carry a stopping axis. The catalog negative control for THIS unit is exactly that runtime stopping predicate. Mapping of that construct fails; the claim that 96+48+64 are ALL expressible without executable policy is therefore not proven, and we stop.
shared_mechanisms.right: expressibility.stop_reason: The unit question permits stopping at the first construct that is not expressible without executable policy. Catalog R-A09 records that CouncilSpec includes a typed-tree expression parser and that protocol/preset specs carry a stopping axis. The catalog negative control for THIS unit is exactly that runtime stopping predicate. Mapping of that construct fails; the claim that 96+48+64 are ALL expressible without executable policy is therefore not proven, and we stop.

shared_mechanisms.right: file role index: Version, load_order listing, sha256 of every loaded file. Files not listed are not loaded.

shared_mechanisms.left: file role rules: One file per rule id. Static JSON only.
shared_mechanisms.right: file role rules: One file per rule id. Static JSON only.

shared_mechanisms.left: file role skills: One file per skill id.
shared_mechanisms.right: file role skills: One file per skill id.

shared_mechanisms.right: file role hooks: Hook registration is data: event name, script path, enable flag. No dispatcher generator.

shared_mechanisms.left: file role mcp-mounts: Server id, transport, tool allow-list as literal strings.
shared_mechanisms.right: file role mcp-mounts: Server id, transport, tool allow-list as literal strings.

shared_mechanisms.right: file role workflow-blueprints: Finite stage lists, declarative stopping (max_stages / halt). No eval.

shared_mechanisms.right: file role council-protocols: Roles, voting, audit as JSON. Expression trees are forbidden.
